name: Offspring
detailed_description:
In a future ravaged by a deadly virus, humanity is falling on the brink of extinction. But amidst the chaos, Dr. Blavius discovers a shocking truth: a rare gene, found in a small subset of the population, holds the key to saving mankind. This gene, carried by only a few, could allow scientists to extract a cure — if it can be passed down through future generations.

That's where YOU come in, an average young man crippled by fear of rejection and lack of self-confidence. While the fate of humanity rests on your ability to find a partner and spread the rare gene, YOU face the daunting challenge of navigating the world of romance, a place where you've always felt like an outsider.

Can YOU overcome your insecurities, face your fears, and form lasting connections? Will you find love, and in doing so, become the key to saving the human race? The future of humanity depends on your choices — but first, YOU have to learn how to take the first step into the unknown world of dating.

Key Features:

  • Heartfelt Romance: You'll navigate complex relationships, overcome your fears, and build meaningful connections with a diverse cast of characters.

  • Sci-Fi Twist: Explore a future on the edge of collapse and unravel the mystery behind the rare gene that holds the fate of the world.

  • Character Growth: Watch yourself evolve from a friendless introvert to a confident individual ready to face his destiny.

  • Story-driven Gameplay: A deep narrative blending the challenges of love, self-discovery, and a world on the brink of annihilation.

Will YOU rise to the challenge? Will you find love, spread your gene, and save humanity? It’s all in your hands. The future may be dead, but there’s still hope — if you can help unlock it.

short_description: Step into the vibrant world of Offspring, a unique dating sim where relationships are forged through twists and turns of self-discovery. In this story-driven game, you’ll fight for love, life and mankind's future as you build meaningful connections with a unique group of women.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
